introduction: Every Day's A Bonus' is a short film comedy that tells the story of a strained relationship between a mother and daughter. Set against the backdrop of a post lockdown world, Jean (77), a widow and Claire (45), a single professional, live their lives at arms length from each other, physically and emotionally, ever since Jean's husband, Ray, died, thirteen years ago. The death of Ray hit them both hard, and as a result, they live separate lives, expressing only tough love, in an unconscious bid to avoid any future heartache by not being too close.
